_original_lore: The Nest Endermite can be found while mining Ender Nodes.
They have a 33.21 chance to spawn from Endstone nodes,
and a 30.54% chance to spawn from Obsidian nodes.
name: 巢穴末影螨 (怪物)

source: The Nest Endermite can be found while mining Ender Nodes.
loreParagraphs.translation: 挖掘末影节点时可以找到巢穴末影螨.

source: They have a {{N0}} chance to spawn from Endstone nodes,
and a {{N1}} chance to spawn from Obsidian nodes.
loreParagraphs.translation: 它们有 {{N0}} 的概率从末地石节点中生成,有 {{N1}} 的概率从黑曜石节点中生成.
